comment:
* Holds user-agent metadata information and uses to generate user-agent client * hints. *

* This class is functionally equivalent to * UADataValues.

variables.name: BITNESS_DEFAULT
variables.comment:
* Use this value for bitness to use the platform's default bitness value, which is an empty
     * string for Android WebView.

methods.name: public List<BrandVersion> getBrandVersionList()
methods.comment:
* Returns the current list of user-agent brand versions which are used to populate * user-agent client hints {@code sec-ch-ua} and {@code sec-ch-ua-full-version-list}. Each * {@link BrandVersion} object holds the brand name, brand major version and brand * full version. *

* @see Builder#setBrandVersionList *

methods.name: public String getFullVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-full-version} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setFullVersion *

methods.name: public String getPlatform()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-platform} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setPlatform *

methods.name: public String getPlatformVersion()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-platform-version} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setPlatformVersion * * @return Platform version string.

methods.name: public String getArchitecture()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-arch} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setArchitecture *

methods.name: public String getModel()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-model} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setModel *

methods.name: public boolean isMobile()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-mobile} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setMobile * * @return A boolean indicates user-agent's device mobileness.

methods.name: public int getBitness()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-bitness} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setBitness * * @return An integer indicates the CPU bitness, the integer value will convert to string * when generating the user-agent client hint, and {@link UserAgentMetadata#BITNESS_DEFAULT} * means an empty string.

methods.name: public boolean isWow64()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for the {@code sec-ch-ua-wow64} client hint. *

* @see Builder#setWow64 * * @return A boolean to indicate whether user-agent's binary is running in 32-bit mode on * 64-bit Windows.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object o)
methods.comment: * Two UserAgentMetadata objects are equal only if all the metadata values are equal.
